tools.description: Structured scientific evidence ledger gateway. Manage sources, exact-locator evidence, and claims in the research workspace.

tools.description: Search arXiv and OpenAlex for OA papers

tools.name: paper_lookup
tools.description: Look up one paper by arXiv id or DOI

tools.name: journal_palette
tools.description: Journal figure hex palettes (100 curated publication palettes for Python)

tools.name: research_compute
tools.description: Scientific calculation gateway: dimensional analysis, numerical spot-checks, and optional SymPy symbolic calculus.

tools.name: research_document
tools.description: Scientific document inspection, section-level parsing, exact text locating, and local ingestion.

tools.name: research_job
tools.description: Asynchronous research task management with state transitions, progress tracking, and structured reporting.
